name: 遺伝性血管浮腫

summary.text: Hereditary angioedema (HAE) is a genetic disease characterized by the occurrence of transitory and recurrent subcutaneous and/or submucosal edemas resulting in swelling and/or abdominal pain.

symptoms.text: transitory and recurrent subcutaneous and/or submucosal edemas
